## What's New in v2.12.1

### New Features — Pitch Editor
- Drag notes up or down to correct the pitch; select several with Ctrl/Shift+click or Ctrl+A
- Apply renders the correction while keeping the original take; Revert brings it back
- Correction presets (Natural, Tight, Hard) with Amount and Vibrato controls
- Key snap and Snap all to key
- Split and Merge notes, plus a MIN setting for how finely a take is divided
- Redesigned side panel with a selection badge, Reset, clip loop and a large time readout

### Improvements
- Opening a project is much faster — unused older pitch-corrected audio is no longer loaded

### Fixes
- Audio In track occasionally going silent after opening a project
- Late-loading tracks staying silent when playback started right after opening
- Merging clips losing each clip's volume
- Pitch Editor restarting the song at the end of a clip placed at the end of the song
- Reset in the Pitch Editor's right-click menu not responding
